themeCards.title: The trade truce now runs until 10 January
themeCards.fact: NBC News: Treasury Secretary Bessent said Wednesday that the Busan trade truce due to end on 10 November is extended until 10 January. 财经早茶 今日图表：中美贸易休战延长两个月，至明年1月10日，习近平抵达美国并受到特朗普高规格礼遇。财经早茶：两国在AI领域沟通渠道的范围尚待确定。
themeCards.mechanism: The truce now runs until 10 January, so the visit opened with a dated extension. CICC (28 July): some bilateral trade has already moved through third countries, so two extra months pause tariffs while the direct route stays rerouted. A/H shares and US equities carry that pause. The theme changes if the extension is walked back, or if a larger package replaces it.
themeCards.trigger: A larger economic package printing before the 10 January expiry.
themeCards.invalidator: The extension being walked back before 10 January.

themeCards.title: The official 10-year yield rose to 5.11%
themeCards.fact: US Treasury: the official 23 September curve printed 4.85% on the 2-year, 4.99% on the 5-year, 5.11% on the 10-year, and 5.40% on the 30-year, after 4.71%, 4.83%, 4.96%, and 5.29% the day before. ABC News: the 10-year yield jumped to 5.11% after business activity and costs rose at the fastest pace in years. 财经早茶 美国债市：国债承压，受强劲PMI数据以及5年期国债招标需求疲软影响。
themeCards.mechanism: The whole curve jumped, with the 2-year at 4.85% and the 10-year at 5.11%, because the activity print and a weak 5-year sale landed together. CICC (24 August): a higher long-end US yield reaches A-shares through cross-border flows and risk mood, and that link is uneven. USTs, US equities, and gold took that jump. The theme fades if the official 10-year reprints at or below 4.96%.

themeCards.title: The Nasdaq record streak ended at 26,936.04
themeCards.fact: ABC News: the Nasdaq composite fell 1.1% to 26,936.04 and the S&P 500 fell 0.8% to 7,706.03. 财经早茶 美国股市：标普500指数创逾一个月最大跌幅，强劲的PMI数据提振加息预期。
themeCards.mechanism: The Nasdaq record streak ended at 26,936.04 because the activity print lifted hike fears. CICC (21 September): AI hardware earnings are still strong, though parts of the chain can split once capacity catches demand. The 26,936.04 close is the US equities book. A new high would be required before this force is live again.
themeCards.invalidator: Nasdaq reprinting at a new high above the prior record.

themeCards.title: Brent November futures settled at 103.08
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻: Brent November futures rose 3.86% to 103.08 dollars a barrel, and WTI November rose 1.81% to 92.16. 财经早茶 能源：布伦特原油回升至100美元之上，对华府颁布出口禁令的担忧推动美国柴油期货隔夜大跌。
themeCards.mechanism: Brent is back at 103.08 because Iran said Hormuz will not be freely used while sanctions remain, which ended the five-day slide. CICC (30 June): the inventory scar from the supply shock can still hold a floor under the price even after a reopening. That 103.08 print is the oil book. The theme fades if a later Brent settle reprints at or below 100.
themeCards.trigger: A later Brent settle at or above 103.08.
themeCards.invalidator: A later Brent settle at or below 100.

themeCards.mechanism: The PBOC is adding 2000亿元 of one-year money ahead of the holiday, a larger add than a routine short-dated roll. 东方金诚 (23 September): the funds support government-bond issuance and keep cash easy. Shanghai at 3936.52 and Hang Seng Tech at 4379.07 are the A/H shares that fell on the day. The theme changes if the MLF operation prints below 8000亿元, or if those equity closes are reversed while the add stands.

themeCards.invalidator: The MLF operation printing below 8000亿元.

themeCards.title: Bitcoin dipped under 84,000 after a rejection near 87,000
themeCards.fact: Cointelegraph: bitcoin briefly traded below 84,000 on 23 September after a rejection near 87,000, with $280 million of long liquidations in four hours. 律动: bitcoin fell 3.85% and briefly dropped below 84,000 after trading above 87,000.
themeCards.mechanism: Bitcoin dipped under 84,000 after a rejection near 87,000 as yields and oil jumped, and about $280 million of longs were liquidated in four hours. Glassnode (23 September): ETF buying is picking up and profit taking is light, so the dip lines up with the macro tape while the ETF bid is still there. That dip is the BTC book. The theme fades if price reprints above 87,000, and it deepens if a later print loses 84,000.

globalRegime: The official Treasury curve jumped after a fast US activity print, and Brent November futures settled back at 103.08 on the 见闻 tape after Iran kept a hard line on Hormuz. The Nasdaq gave back its record. Bessent extended the US-China trade truce until 10 January while Xi is in Washington, which is the 财经早茶 chart.

France and other non-core euro bonds sold off as oil lifted ECB hike bets, so the European rates book is on the same inflation line as Treasuries.
